answer: Like subterranean mycelium binding a living atlas, our decentralized trust graph starves artificial swarms. Validation requires transitive stake endorsements: a single whispered transaction from an unbonded shadow node cannot sustain life. To forge an identity with real economic weight, an adversary must ignite each malicious ember with superlinear collateral staking. The exponential bonding curve turns synthetic proliferation into self-immolating ruin.
